L8-19 LayoutManagerProps: all ten props (dashboards, activeId, onSwitch, onCreate, onRename, onDelete, onReorder, onDuplicate, onOpenSettings, onOpenTemplates?) ported verbatim into the native interface.

L21-54 CtxItem: the full-width ghost UiButton menu row -> a Pressable row; the lucide icon component prop becomes a `glyph` string, danger red text + disabled opacity-30 preserved, and the hover:bg becomes the Pressable pressed state (surfaceRaised / red-500/10).
L56-73 LayoutManager signature + state: editingId, editName, isCreating, newName all preserved as useState; inputRef (HTMLInputElement) -> useRef<TextInput> (.focus() unchanged). t = the shim.

L75-81 drag + L79-81 context-menu state: dragIndex/dragOverIndex preserved as useState (mirrored to refs for the once-created PanResponder); ctxMenu preserved as { x, y, dashId }. The web ctxRef DOM ref (outside-click detection) is dropped because the Modal backdrop handles it (documented).

L83-100 close-menu useEffect (document mousedown-outside + keydown Escape): replaced by the Modal's full-screen backdrop Pressable onPress (outside tap) + onRequestClose (hardware back = Escape); the effect itself is therefore unnecessary on native.

L102-110 handleContextMenu: ported verbatim incl. the MENU_W=180/MENU_H=160 viewport clamp, now against Dimensions.get('window') using the long-press nativeEvent.pageX/pageY (web onContextMenu/right-click -> native onLongPress; e.preventDefault is web-only and dropped).

L112-137 HTML5 drag handlers (handleDragStart/Over/Drop/End, dataTransfer.effectAllowed/dropEffect/setDragImage): the browser Drag API is reproduced with one PanResponder on the tab row — onMoveShouldSetPanResponder claims a horizontal drag, onPanResponderGrant hit-tests dragIndex from locationX, onPanResponderMove tracks dragOverIndex by nearest tab centre, and onPanResponderRelease/Terminate calls onReorder(from,to) for a changed slot then resets both indices. setDragImage has no native analog and is dropped; scrolling is locked while dragging (scrollEnabled={dragIndex===null}).

L139-170 startRename/confirmRename/startCreate/confirmCreate: ported verbatim — name.trim() guards, the onOpenTemplates short-circuit, and the setTimeout(()=>inputRef.current?.focus(),50) focus all preserved unchanged.

L172-173 ctxDash lookup preserved (dashboards.find by ctxMenu.dashId). L175-177 the Fragment + `overflow-x-auto` strip -> a horizontal ScrollView wrapping a content View that carries the PanResponder.

L178-246 tab loop: each dashboard -> a tabWrapper View (onLayout records its x/width for hit-testing) holding either the inline-rename row or the tab Pressable. onClick->onPress switch, onContextMenu->onLongPress menu, draggable handlers->the row PanResponder.
